mentions.name: Gouach
mentions.description: This project builds repairable electric bike (ebike) batteries designed and made by a French team of engineers and designers, and has just released its first consumer (B2C) model.
mentions.audience: Consumers (the first model released is business-to-consumer).
mentions.source_excerpt:
We're french engineers/designers working on building repairable ebike batteries!

We just released our first B2C model, check it out at https://gouach.com :)
